intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 badminton 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 my sister took up ① badminton in a hall with nine windows and one net, and my father said the net was the whole of it. The ② badminton, meaning the game and not the evening, lasted nine years and one ankle; badminton, she said, is the only sport in which the thing you hit is designed not to come back. He said that is why it suits her.

Every ③ badminton in that hall was played in the same hour and finished in the same silence. Their ④ badminton on Thursdays cost nine pence and a lift home; badminton, my mother said, is the only game that is easier indoors and harder in a wind. She said the wind is the real opponent.

My uncle said ⑤ badminton was tennis for people who could not find a wall, and my sister said that was the truest thing he had ever said. The ⑥ badminton, meaning the sport and not the game that evening, is nine parts wrist and one part patience; badminton, my father said, is the only sport where the winning shot is the one you did not hit. He said the patience is the difficult half.

By 1978 the ⑦ badminton had become a league and the league had become nine rules and a fine. The ⑧ badminton she played in the garden in June lasted four minutes and ended in the hedge; badminton, my mother said, is either a sport or something you do in a garden, and only one of them has a score. She said the hedge won that one.

The ⑨ badminton I remember is the Thursday one, in the hall with nine windows, which she never missed for eleven years. ⑩ Badminton, my father said in 1984, is the only game in which the best shot is the one that stops; every game of it, he said, is a rally that somebody has decided not to lose.
